files.description: Product returns in March (80 rows): return_id (whole number), quantity (whole number), refund (two decimals). Same columns as returns_april.csv.
Product returns in April: the header row (return_id, quantity, refund, as in returns_march.csv) and no data rows, because nothing was returned in April.

task_text: Combine the March and April returns. For each quantity value, give the average refund rounded to 2 decimals. `result` should be a table indexed by quantity with a column refund.
intended_computation: Over all returns of both months (April is empty), group by quantity (1 to 4) and average refund; round each average to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: On 3.x the combined refund column is text-like, so the pivot table holds generic values and round(2) leaves them unrounded; 2.x kept refund numeric and rounded.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
